description: Downstream-application compatibility request. This file specifies what the downstream inference program can consume; it is not one of the generated context/user-study cases.

request_identity.natural_language_request: Provide the image-frame and audio-waveform sample/manifest required by the YouHome audio-visual ADL classifier.

source_requirements.notes: The default YouHome app request is multimodal. Do not substitute activity labels, pose labels, sound labels, or ADL summaries as preprocessing output unless a different downstream app contract explicitly accepts those formats.

utility_contract.task_description: Run the downstream YouHome AV classifier over image frames and audio and emit an ADL class.

accepted_output_caps.utility_notes: Compatible with infer_youhome.py because the downstream YouHomeAVDataset yields both image and audio tensors to the AVADLClassifier.
Only compatible if the trained checkpoint metadata indicates a video/image-only modality rather than AV.
Only compatible if the trained checkpoint metadata indicates audio-only modality rather than AV.

explicitly_rejected_output_caps.reason: The YouHome ADL classifier produces activity labels; it does not consume them as input.
The attached infer_youhome.py path loads image and audio tensors, not pose-only features.
Sound labels alone omit required visual/audio payload for the AV ADL model.
A coarse ADL summary is a downstream result or report, not a valid model input.

downstream_program.name: infer_youhome.py
downstream_program.input_kind: manifest plus data_root loaded by YouHomeAVDataset
downstream_program.model_role: The downstream program classifies ADLs from image and audio tensors.

compatibility_notes: For the default AV checkpoint, a valid output must package both image/video frames and audio waveform references.
Video-only or audio-only caps are conditional compatibility options only when the checkpoint metadata says the trained model uses that modality.

compatibility_constraints.accepted_schema_match: candidate output caps must match at least one accepted_output_caps entry
compatibility_constraints.required_capability_match: candidate utility_capabilities must include requested_capability or a declared equivalent
adapter_rules: Adapters may repackage data into the manifest/sample schema required by the downstream program only when the underlying payload type remains compatible.
A privacy-minimized semantic label is not utility-compatible unless the downstream program explicitly accepts that semantic label as input.

residual_disclosure_constraints.comparison_rule: candidate residual disclosure vector must be <= max_allowed for every attribute, except attributes listed in allowed_high_attributes

no_compromise_conditions: Return no_compromise if no candidate pipeline both matches an accepted output cap and satisfies CI/residual-disclosure constraints.
Return insufficient_utility_evidence if the output cap/schema is accepted but no benchmark, calibration, or app-provided validation exists.
Do not select a semantic/privacy-minimized output solely because it is acceptable under CI if the downstream inference program cannot consume it.
